title: Joining Curtis Mosby at the Apex Club
summary: He left the Cotton Club for Mosby's Apex on Central Avenue, alternating months of show in Los Angeles and San Francisco.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well, after Louis's first trip here, then we sort of shifted the -- well, I went out of the club, and I went down with Curtis Mosby, who had the Apex Club down on Central. And I traveled with him for a few months.

We -- the Apex had a policy. We would play one month in Los Angeles, then we'd go to San Francisco and play one month. And they would take the show from L. A. and play it in San Francisco. Then they would come back to Los Angeles to change the show for the next tour.
Was the Apex the club next to the Dunbar Hotel?
Yes. Yes, it was downstairs there on
The one that later became the Club Alabam.
Yeah, the Club Alabam. So it was quite a good entertaining thing you know to play music in those days. It was --
